title: Hotfix wargame list crash
body:
Hotfix for game crashing with this error:

```
react-dom.production.min.js.209
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading "toLowerCase")
At A (index.tsx:27:34)
At Array.filter (<anonymous>)
At P (index.tsx:46:57)
At t.WargameList (index.tsx:77:12)
Then there's more ats, including $o, Mc, Al, ml, cl

And a second error that is almost identical, except the first two lines are
react-dom.production.min.js.123
Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading "toLowerCase")
```
